name: mmmtrc
stderr:
MoMeet — transcribe local meeting audio and Google Meet calls.

Usage: mmmtrc [--json | --json-errors] <command> [arguments]

Commands:
  transcribe                    Transcribe a local audio or video file and return unnamed speaker labels for naming.
  name-speakers                 Apply speaker names to a finished transcript and write it as Markdown.
  meet-start                    Send the recording bot into a Google Meet call.
  meet-status                   Read a meeting's state and the transcript recorded since your cursor, plus supplemental Meet captions since your caption cursor.
  meet-stop                     Stop the recording bot and return the meeting's immediate final state.
  meet-schedule                 Schedule the bot to record a Google Meet call at a future time.
  meet-schedules                List scheduled recordings — upcoming by default, any state with all.
  meet-schedule-cancel          Cancel a pending scheduled recording.
  meet-schedule-status          Read one scheduled recording by its id.
  meet-noti-creds               Snapshot this machine's WhatsApp and Google Workspace credentials to the meet backend.
  meet-noti-set                 Set where notifications about scheduled recordings are sent.
  meet-noti-status              Show stored notification credentials, destinations, and recent deliveries.
  meet-calendars-sources        Show which Google Calendars feed the meeting agenda and what can be chosen.
  meet-calendars-set-sources    Set which Google Calendars feed the meeting agenda.
  meet-vocabulary-status        Show the vocabulary terms, their status and misheard forms, and the library revision.
  meet-vocabulary-add           Add a term to the vocabulary library by hand.
  meet-vocabulary-edit          Correct the spelling of an existing vocabulary term.
  meet-vocabulary-add-misheard  Record an additional misheard form for an existing vocabulary term.
  meet-vocabulary-pin           Pin a vocabulary term so it is always included in recognition context, or unpin it.
  meet-vocabulary-set-status    Change the status of a vocabulary term (watching, active, or off).
  meet-vocabulary-delete        Delete a term from the vocabulary library.
  meet                          Join a Google Meet call and stream its transcript here until it ends.
  meet-audio                    Save a meeting's recording to a file on this machine.
  login                         Log this machine in to the shared meet backend so meeting tools act on this user's meetings.
  google-login                  Open this user's recording-bot Google sign-in page on the capture host, or close it for recovery.
  mcp                           Serve record, transcribe and name_speakers to an MCP client over stdio.
  install                       Register the MCP server with the agent hosts on this machine.
  uninstall                     Remove that registration, leaving every other server in place.
  version                       Print the version of MoMeet running here.
  help                          Print this overview, or the help for one command.

Run `mmmtrc <command> --help` for one command, or `mmmtrc <command> --schema` for its
machine-readable input, output, errors and exit codes.

Output:
  stdout carries the result only; progress, failures and the closing summary go to stderr.
  --json         one contractVersion 1 document on stdout (mmmtrc meet --json streams NDJSON).
  --json-errors  keep the text result, but report failures as that same document on stderr.
  --             ends option parsing, so a following value may start with a dash.

Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 failed · 2 usage · 3 notFound · 4 notReady · 5 provider · 6 configuration · 7 cancelled · 8 conflict.

Configuration:
  WIUM_AUTH_FILE      the Web-minted API key installed by login --apiKey.
  WIUM_MEET_BOT_URL   the capture service `meet`, `meet-start`, `meet-status` and `meet-stop` talk to.
